summary: Iteration 44: WhatsApp-Based Support System Testing - All features working correctly. Support Page shows WhatsApp CTA + 6 categories + phone number. Chat Widget opens with WhatsApp support button and category selector. Vendor Support has WhatsApp CTA + ticket history. Admin Ticket Panel shows WhatsApp source badges. Backend webhook auto-creates tickets from WhatsApp messages. Guest access to /support works (cart redirects to home with drawer open - intentional).
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: support_ticket_routes.py was not registered in server.py - added import and include_router
FIXED: ChatWidget was not imported/rendered in App.js - added import and component to LayoutWrapper
FIXED: Admin tickets route and nav item were missing - added /admin/tickets route and Support Tickets nav item
context_for_next_testing_agent: WhatsApp-based support system is fully functional. Support ticket routes are now registered in server.py. ChatWidget is rendered in App.js. Admin tickets panel accessible at /admin/tickets. All WhatsApp links use phone number 919625992057. Webhook at POST /api/whatsapp/webhook auto-creates tickets from message_received events.

support_page.details: WhatsApp CTA, 6 category buttons (Order Issue, Payment, Refund/Return, Account/Login, Technical Bug, General), phone number +91 9625992057, guest accessible

support_page_logged_in.details: Shows 'Your Support History' section with ticket list when logged in

chat_widget.details: Gold button opens widget, shows 'Chat & Raise Ticket on WhatsApp' green button, 'I have a specific issue' category selector with 6 categories

vendor_support.details: Green WhatsApp CTA button + ticket history visible at /vendor/support

admin_ticket_panel.details: Tickets display with WhatsApp source badge (green), admin can view/assign/change status

webhook_duplicate_handling.details: Duplicate messages within 5 minutes append to existing ticket

webhook_cod_filter.details: COD confirmation messages (yes/confirm) do NOT create tickets

guest_access.details: /support accessible without login, /cart opens drawer and redirects to home (intentional)

mocked_apis.interakt_auto_reply: May fail silently without API key configured
